test_title: PYST 36: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The RTE Act bears many similarities to the US's No Child Left Behind Act, ______ school accountability, assessment standards and teacher training.
solution:
The correct answer is __**including**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The above blank should be filled with word including.
 
• The word **including** is a preposition which means containing as a component of the whole under consideration.
 
• Example : All the students **including **class teachers are requested to come to ground.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
